blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Conspiratorial discourse on social media is not always expressed through explicit claims or stable lexical markers. The same surface content may express endorsement, legitimate concerns, criticism, satire, or mockery. The main challenge is therefore not only recognizing conspiracy-related claims, but inferring the speaker’s intent – the utterance’s illocutionary force. We argue that this can be achieved through the use of relevant social contexts and propose an agentic framework, equipped with a set of tools supporting social queries. We demonstrate the benefits of our approach on a unique dataset of Hebrew tweets, covering 80%–90% of the public Hebrew tweets published over a four-year span (late 2018– early 2023), encompassing several election cycles as well as the COVID pandemic years and related vaccination campaigns. This extensive coverage can be used in recovering different social contexts.
Evaluating our framework on a manually-annotated adversarial dataset, we find that context-aware workflows consistently outperform text-only classification and that the agentic framework performs significantly better than other frameworks and settings, including a non-agentic model exposed to the same contexts available to the agent.
We further provide an analysis of the results, the errors and efficiency (token economy) tradeoffs. These findings support viewing the task of conspiracy detection as a socially embedded interpretation task, in which effective classification depends not only on access to contexts, but also on adaptive reasoning in which the agent uses tools on a per-case basis, asking only for evidence relevant to its current reasoning step.
blocks.zh:
有关社交媒体的阴谋性言论并不总是通过明确的主张或稳定的词汇标记来表达。 同样的表面内容可能表达赞同、合理关切、批评、讽刺或嘲笑。 因此,主要的挑战不仅在于承认与阴谋有关的主张,而且在于推论演讲者的意图 — — 言论的不良力量。 我们主张,可以通过利用相关的社会环境来实现这一点,并提议一个代理框架,配备一套支持社会查询的工具。 我们用希伯来语推文这个独特的数据集来展示我们的做法的好处,该套推文覆盖了四年间(2018年末至2023年初)公开发表的希伯来语推文的80~90%,涵盖多个选举周期以及COVID流行年份和相关接种运动. 这种广泛的覆盖面可用于恢复不同的社会环境。
在评估我们框架的人工附加说明的对抗数据集时,我们发现,对上下文的认识工作流程一贯优于只使用文本的分类,代理框架的绩效大大优于其他框架和设置,包括接触代理商相同背景的非代理模型。
我们进一步分析了结果、错误和效率(经济)权衡。 这些调查结果支持将阴谋探测任务视为一项社会嵌入式解释任务,其中有效的分类不仅取决于接触环境,还取决于代理人在个案基础上使用工具的适应性推理,仅要求与其当前推理步骤相关的证据.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Social media has become a central arena for the circulation of misinformation, rumors, and conspiracy theories ( Grinberg et al. 2019 ; Muhammed and Mathew 2022 ) . Commonly referred to as alternative narratives ( Starbird 2017 ) , they are spread and consumed through an ecosystem that combines influencers with various motivations, 1 1 1 Motivations range from pure monetary gain, to the perception of self, sense of belonging, or goals of nation-state actors. committed communities, and the participation of ordinary users ( Starbird et al. 2019 ) .
These narratives tend to gain traction beyond fringe communities, especially in times of declining trust in institutions: increased political polarization, social unrest, economic or public-health crises, and wars – times in which these ‘bespoke realities’ are ever more dangerous ( Douglas and Sutton 2023 ; Allen et al. 2024 ; DiResta 2024 ; Hilberts et al. 2025 ) . Support-for and participation-in political violence were found to be correlated with beliefs in conspiracy theories, especially those held by small homogeneous groups ( Enders et al. 2024 ) .
The analysis of the patterns of conspiratorial discourse is of great interest to academic scholars, policy-makers, and the online platforms serving as the main vehicle for the phenomena.
However, the detection of conspiratorial discourse is theoretically and algorithmically
challenging ( Mahl et al. 2023 ) .
Conspiratorial discourse is not well defined. The same surface-level text may serve different communicative acts, ranging from false narratives to legitimate concerns 2 2 2 E.g., “ Is Tylenol safe during pregnancy? ” , and mockery. 3 3 3 E.g., “ The COVID vaccine is designed to be activated by a 5G cellular signal, triggering a tail growth ” and see Fact Check: COVID-19 vaccines are not a ploy to connect people to 5G; Accessed 7/30/26. The challenge is more pronounced in short and informal communication styles prevalent in some online social platforms, and among members of cohesive communities using in-group jargon.
Moreover, challenging a dogma with alternative narratives can prove true, 4 4 4 Consider the legacy of Copernicus, Galileo Galilei, or Woodward and Bernstein’s reporting on the Watergate break-in. exposing bad actors or promoting a just cause ( Jackson et al. 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
社会媒体已成为传播错误信息、谣言和阴谋论的中心舞台(Grinberg等人,2019年;Muhammed和Mathew,2022年)。 通常称为另类叙事(Starbird 2017),它们通过一个将影响者与各种动机相结合的生态系统传播和消耗,11 1 动机从纯货币收益,到对自我的感知,归属感,或民族国家行为者的目标. 承诺社区,以及普通用户的参与(Starbird等人,2019年).

blocks.en: In this work we follow the working definition provided by Douglas and Sutton (2023) : “A conspiracy theory is a belief that two or more actors have coordinated in secret to achieve an outcome and that their conspiracy is of public interest but not public knowledge.” Conspiracy theories are (a) oppositional; (b) describe malevolent acts; (c) ascribe agency to small groups; (d) epistemically risky; and (e) shared in order to form new social realities.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们遵循道格拉斯和萨顿(2023年)提供的工作定义: “阴谋论是一种信念,即两个或两个以上行为者为取得结果进行了秘密协调,他们的阴谋符合公共利益,但并不为公众所知。” 阴谋论是:(a) 反对;(b) 描述恶意行为;(c) 将机构归于小团体;(d) 具有普遍风险;(e) 分享以便形成新的社会现实。

blocks.en: In this work we propose an agentic approach for the detection of conspiratorial discourse. We first demonstrate the shortcomings of text-based approaches, then introduce our agentic framework: given a specific social media post, the agent can call tools to sample more content from the user, inspect the user’s metadata, query the user’s social circle, or utilize the structure of the social network.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了侦测阴谋论的代理方法。 我们首先展示基于文字的方法的缺点,然后介绍我们的代理框架:鉴于一个特定的社交媒体帖子,代理商可以调用工具从用户中抽取更多内容,检查用户的元数据,查询用户的社会圈,或者利用社交网络的结构.

blocks.en: Table 1: Examples illustrating context-dependent Hebrew conspiracy-tweet classification. Tweets are shown in English translation, and original Hebrew texts appear in Appendix B . Gold is the human label, where 1 indicates conspiracy endorsement and 0 indicates non-conspiracy. GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Flash are text-only predictions.
blocks.zh: 表1:说明希伯来人阴谋诡计分类的事例。 图文以英文翻译,希伯来文原文见附录B。 黄金是人类的标签,其中1表示阴谋背书,0表示非阴谋. GPT-5和双子座3 Flash是仅限文本的预测.

blocks.en:
The shortcomings of text-based classification are illustrated in Table 1 through five examples: both GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Flash agree on the correct prediction in examples 1&5, agree on an incorrect prediction in example 2, and diverge over examples 3–4.
Temporal context may be needed when a tweet indirectly refers to a recent event or news cycle. Conversational context may be needed when a tweet responds to, quotes, or mocks another post. Social context may be needed when interpretation depends on the author’s usual stance, community, or repeated narratives. In such cases, the isolated tweet text may be insufficient to determine whether the author is endorsing a conspiracy narrative, criticizing it, joking about it, or merely reporting on it. In many such cases, the key distinction is therefore not whether conspiracy-related content is present, but whether the speaker is committed to it.
blocks.zh:
表1通过五个例子说明了文本分类的缺点:GPT-5和双子座3 Flash在例1和例5中都同意正确的预测,在例2中也同意不正确的预测,与例3-4有分歧.
当微博间接提及最近的事件或新闻周期时,可能需要时间背景。 当微博回应、引用或嘲笑另一篇文章时, 当解释取决于作者的通常立场、社区或反复叙述时,可能需要社会背景。 在这种情况下,孤立的微博文本可能不足以确定提交人是否赞同阴谋叙事、批评、开玩笑,或仅仅是报道。 因此,在很多这类情况下,主要的区别不是是否存在与阴谋有关的内容,而是发言者是否承诺这样做。

blocks.en:
We argue that conspiracy-tweet classification should be treated as a contextual interpretation task rather than a purely textual classification task. Relevant context may come from several levels of the social-media environment: tweet-level metadata, the author’s profile, the author’s previous posts, and the interaction network surrounding the user. We treat these signals as contextual hints rather than as direct proof of user intent.
For example, consider the following tweet: H1 “Those naive people don’t realize the storm is part of Pfizer’s secret plot to take over the world, setting the New World Order. There’s no hope for you. ’’ 5 5 5 Original Hebrew text is provided in Appendix B , Example H1.
blocks.zh:
我们主张,阴谋-图密分类应作为背景解释任务,而不是纯粹的文字分类任务。 相关背景可能来自社会媒体环境的几个层面:微博层面的元数据,作者的简介,作者以前的帖子,以及围绕用户的互动网络. 我们把这些信号视为背景提示而不是用户意图的直接证明.
例如,考虑以下推文: H1“那些天真的人不知道暴风雨是辉瑞控制世界的秘密阴谋的一部分, 你没有希望。 附录B,例H1提供了希伯来文原文。

blocks.en:
The true label of the tweet is non-conspiracy. The multiple, very explicit conspiracy markers are used sarcastically, as the text suggests that a severe winter storm 6 6 6 “Winter Storm Carmel Brings One Month’s Worth of Rainfall to Israel”. Haaretz, 12/22/2021. Accessed 9/14/2026. is part of a plot involving the Pfizer vaccine.
Table 2 shows how different workflows interpret the tweet. The text-only model mistakes strong conspiracy markers for endorsement, while contextual workflows recover the sarcastic reading using the storm context, the author’s profile, prior weather-related posts, and ego-network evidence. The agents-debate workflow also reaches the correct label, reasoning about the absurdity and the parodic nature of the text.
blocks.zh:
微博的真实标签是非阴谋. 许多非常明确的阴谋标记被讽刺地使用,因为案文表明一场严重的冬季风暴6 6 6 " 卡梅尔风暴给以色列带来一个月的降雨价值 " 。 《国土报》,12/22/2021。 获得9/14/2026是辉瑞疫苗阴谋的一部分。
表2显示了不同工作流程对微博的解释. 仅文本模型错误了强烈的阴谋标记以供认可,而背景工作流程则利用风暴背景、作者的简介、先前与天气有关的帖子和自我网络证据来恢复讽刺读物。 代理-辩论工作流程也达到了正确的标签,推理了文本的荒谬性和讽刺性.

blocks.zh: 表2:由于同一文本(H1)的背景不同,代理推理的变化。 标签遵循二进制注解计划:1表示阴谋背书,0表示非阴谋. 每个设置将原始的微博与该行指定的上下文结合.

blocks.en:
However, simply appending all available contexts to every tweet, as part of the input, is neither efficient nor necessarily desirable.
Providing excessive contexts may introduce noise and harm performance ( Shi et al. 2023 ) . Agentic workflows are, therefore, suitable for this setting as an agent can reason and decide what tool should be used next, or whether the data available is sufficient.
blocks.zh:
然而,简单地将所有可用的背景附加到每个推文中,作为输入的一部分,既不有效,也不一定可取。
提供过多的环境可能带来噪音和损害性能(Shi等人)。 2023 (英语). 因此,代理工作流程适合这一设置,因为代理工作流程可以解释并决定下一步应使用何种工具,或者现有数据是否足够。

blocks.en: We evaluate our agentic approach on a unique and challenging dataset of Hebrew tweets. The agentic approach achieves the best results compared with both the text-only LLM baseline and the corresponding preloaded-context conditions, improving F1 from 0.535 to 0.730 over the text-only LLM. We further experiment with a “Socratic” two-agent setting, in which one agent questions the reasoning of another agent, encouraging critical reflection. Finally, we provide an analysis of the tool-use behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们用希伯来语推文来评价我们的代理方法, 与仅文本的LLM基线和相应的预装文本条件相比,代理方法取得了最佳效果,比仅文本的LLM提高了F1从0.535提高到0.730. 我们进一步试验一种“ socratic”的双剂设置,其中一个剂质问另一个剂的推理,鼓励批判性的思考. 最后,我们提供了对工具使用行为的分析。

blocks.en:
Specifically, we focus on the Israeli X (formerly Twitter) ecosystem, leveraging a unique dataset estimated to cover 80–90% of public Hebrew tweets from December 2018 to June 2023.
Low-resource and morphologically rich languages such as Arabic and Hebrew add yet another layer of complexity to the task of algorithmic detection of conspiratorial discourse. The challenge stems not only from ambiguity introduced by the rich morphology, but also from the limited training over the language of a secluded community of speakers.
The dataset spans multiple waves of a global pandemic as well as five general-election cycles reflecting intense political tensions, a fertile ground for contentious narratives, conspiratorial thinking, and increased polarization.
Together, these social and linguistic conditions make Hebrew conspiracy-tweet classification a particularly challenging setting for automatic detection.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,我们关注以色列X(前Twitter)生态系统,利用一个独特的数据集,估计2018年12月至2023年6月将覆盖80-90%的希伯来语公共推文.
阿拉伯语和希伯来语等资源贫乏和形态丰富的语言,为算法检测密谋言论的任务又增加了一层复杂性. 这一挑战不仅源于丰富的形态学带来的模糊不清,还源于对一个偏僻的演讲者群体语言的培训有限。
数据集涵盖全球大流行的多波以及五个大选周期,反映了强烈的政治紧张局势、有争议的叙事的肥沃土壤、阴谋思潮和两极分化加剧。
这些社会和语言条件共同使希伯来阴谋诡计分类成为自动检测的极具挑战性的场所.

blocks.en: Evaluating our context-aware agentic retrieval as well as heterogeneous two-agent “debate” framework, the contribution of this paper is threefold: (i) We demonstrate that the use of various contexts significantly improves the detection of conspiratorial posts, (ii) We explore the patterns of efficient tool-usage, and (iii) We analyze the economical gains facilitated by the agentic framework.
blocks.zh: 本文评估了我们的环境意识代理人检索以及多种多样的双代理人“辩论”框架,其贡献有三个方面:(一) 我们表明,利用各种背景大大改进了对同谋职位的探测;(二) 我们探索高效工具使用模式;(三) 我们分析代理人框架所促进的经济收益。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The World Economic Forum’s Global Risks Report 2026 ( World Economic Forum 2026 ) lists misinformation and disinformation among the “most severe global risks”.
blocks.zh: 世界经济论坛的《2026年全球风险报告》(2026年世界经济论坛)将错误信息和错误信息列为 " 最严重的全球风险 " 。

blocks.en: False narratives are often emotionally engaging and more appealing than accurate information ( Vosoughi et al. 2018 ) , making them an effective tool for garnering attention and promoting political agendas ( Starbird 2017 ; Starbird et al. 2019 ) . Conspiracy theories are a prominent form of this broader information disorder, explaining complex societal, political, medical, or global events as the result of secret plots by powerful actors. The appeal of conspiratorial claims is associated with the needs for certainty, control, identity, and belonging ( Douglas et al. 2017 ; Douglas et al. 2019 ) . Examples include claims that vaccines cause autism or that climate change is a deliberate fraud ( Del Vicario et al. 2016 ) . In Israel, a 2015 survey found that 19% questioned the identity of Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin’s assassin, while 35% questioned some part of the official account ( Caspit 2015 ) .
blocks.zh: 虚假的叙事往往在情感上参与,比准确的信息更具吸引力(Vosoughi等人,2018年),使其成为吸引关注和促进政治议程的有效工具(Starbird 2017;Starbird等人,2019年). 阴谋论是这种更广泛的信息混乱的一种突出形式,解释由于强大行为者的秘密阴谋而导致的复杂的社会,政治,医疗或全球事件. 对共谋索赔的上诉涉及确定性、控制、身份和归属的需要(Douglas等人,2017年;Douglas等人,2019年)。 例如,有人声称疫苗导致自闭症,或气候变化是蓄意欺诈(Del Vicario等人,2016年)。 以色列2015年的一项调查发现,19%的人质疑总理伊扎克·拉宾的刺客身份,35%的人质疑官方帐户(Caspit 2015)的某些部分.

blocks.en: Online platforms serve as the vehicle through which various narratives are shared and reinforced. Existing network structures are harnessed and new communities are created and maintained by committed individuals. These communities provide a sense of belonging, promoting bespoke interpretations of reality ( Del Vicario et al. 2016 ; Douglas et al. 2017 ) .
blocks.zh: 在线平台是分享和加强各种叙事的工具。 现有网络结构得到利用,新的社区由坚定的个人建立和维持。 这些社区提供一种归属感,促进对现实的口头解释(Del Vicario等人)。 2016 ; Douglas et al. 2017 ).

blocks.en: This “asymmetry of passion” ( DiResta 2024 ) allows small but highly committed online groups to amplify fringe narratives, creating an illusion of consensus and achieving offline impact ( Vosoughi et al. 2018 ; Starbird et al. 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种“激情的不对称性”(DiResta 2024)使得小型但高度执着的在线团体能够扩展边缘叙事,形成共识幻觉并实现线下影响(Vosoughi等人,2018年;Starbird等人,2019年).

blocks.en: The body of computational work explicitly addressing the detection of conspiracy theories is surprisingly sparse. This subsection provides a brief survey of the literature as well as relevant works concerned with related tasks such as stance detection and the classification of ‘fake news’ and misinformation.
blocks.zh: 明确涉及侦测阴谋论的计算工作数量之少令人惊讶。 本小节简要地调查了文献以及与相关任务有关的著作,如定位探测和对 " 假新闻 " 和错误信息的分类。

blocks.en:
Treating conspiracies as narrative structures, rather than true/false statements, Shahsavari et al. (2020) combine semantic role labeling, BERT embeddings, clustering, and community detection to uncover the narratives in emerging COVID-19 conspiracy theories.
Similarly, Lei and Huang (2023) enhance a transformer-based classifier with event-relation graphs to capture narrative structure in long-form news, showing that such structural information improves conspiracy detection and generalization to unseen media sources.
Beyond purely textual representations, Steffen (2025) use unsupervised multimodal topic modeling to analyze textual and visual conspiracy discourse in German-language Telegram channels.
blocks.zh:
Shahsavari等人(2020年)将阴谋视为叙事结构,而不是真实/虚假的言论,将语义角色标签,BERT嵌入,集群,和社区检测结合起来,以揭示新兴的COVID-19阴谋论中的叙事.
同样,雷和黄(2023年)加强了基于变压器的分类器,带有事件关系图,在长式新闻中捕捉叙事结构,显示这种结构信息可以改善阴谋的侦测和对隐蔽媒体来源的概括.
除了纯粹的文字表述外,Steffen(2025年)使用不受监督的多式联运主题模型分析德语Telegram频道的文字和视觉阴谋论.

blocks.en:
A number of datasets related to various conspiracy theories were also made available. COCO provides tweets covering twelve types of COVID-related conspiracies, together with benchmarks for stance and topic classification ( Langguth et al. 2023 ) . YouNICon extends such resources to YouTube, providing a large-scale collection of conspiracy-related videos with manually labeled subsets for conspiracy detection and topic classification ( Liaw et al. 2023 ) .
Related work has also evaluated transformer-based models on topic-diverse conspiracy data. Phillips et al. (2022) introduce a Twitter dataset that spans climate change, COVID-19 origins and vaccines, and the Epstein-Maxwell trial, and evaluate models of the BERT-family for conspiracy, stance, and topic classification.
Based on this data set, George et al. (2024) augment a RoBERTa-based conspiracy classifier with text-derived psycho-linguistic features that capture emotion and moral framing, showing that these additional signals improve classification over text alone.
Extending this line of work beyond topic-specific classification, Fort et al. (2023) examine whether models trained on one conspiracy topic can generalize to unseen topics. They find that BART outperforms SVM baselines, but cross-topic performance remains variable and can decline substantially.
blocks.zh:
还提供了一些与各种阴谋论有关的数据集。 COCO提供12种与COVID有关的阴谋的推文,以及立场和主题分类的基准(Langguth等人,2023年). YouNICON将此类资源扩展至YouTube, 提供大规模收集的阴谋相关视频,
相关工作还评估了基于变压器的关于专题多样性阴谋数据的模型。 菲利普斯等人著. (2022年)引入了一个涵盖气候变化,COVID-19起源和疫苗,以及Epstein-Maxwell试验的Twitter数据集,并评价BERT家族的模型,用于阴谋,姿态,以及主题分类.
根据本数据集,George et al. (2024年)增加了一个基于RoBERTa的阴谋分类器,其文字衍生的心理语言特征能够捕捉情感和道德框架,表明这些额外的信号改善了单文本的分类.
Fort等人(2023年)将这项工作范围扩大到特定专题的分类之外,研究是否就一个阴谋专题受过培训的模型可以被概括到看不见的专题。 他们发现BART的性能超过了SVM基线,但跨专题性能仍然不尽相同,可以大幅下降.

blocks.en: Diab et al. (2024) further show that discussing a conspiracy does not necessarily imply endorsing it, using human-labeled Reddit posts to train BERT-family classifiers and evaluate zero- and few-shot GPT prompting for distinguishing conspiracy endorsement from criticism, skepticism, and debunking.
blocks.zh: Diab等人(2024年)进一步显示,讨论阴谋并不一定意味着认可阴谋,他们利用贴人标签的Reddit帖子来训练BERT-家族分类人员,并评价零镜头和零镜头的GPT,促使他们区分阴谋认可与批评,怀疑主义,以及解禁.

blocks.en:
A few works use LLMs for conspiracy-related tasks. LLMs were found to perform similarly to fine-tuned transformers in detecting conspiracies in German Telegram data ( Pustet et al. 2024 ) . Liu et al. (2024) instruction-tune an emotion-oriented LLM for conspiracy detection, topic classification, and stance-related tasks, showing improvements over general-purpose LLMs and ChatGPT on most evaluated tasks.
Complementarily, Corso et al. (2025) evaluate open-weights LLMs in a zero-shot setting for detecting conspiracy theories from TikTok video transcripts, finding that some prompting configurations achieve high precision, outperforming a fine-tuned RoBERTa baseline, although performance varies substantially across models and prompts.
blocks.zh:
少数作品将LLMS用于与阴谋有关的任务. 发现LLMS在探测德国Telegram数据中的阴谋时,其性能与微调变压器类似(Pustet等人,2024年)。 刘等. (2024年) 指令调整一种以情感为导向的LLM,用于阴谋探测,主题分类,和姿态相关任务,显示在大多数评估任务上比通用LLM和ChatGPT有所改进.
作为补充,Corso等人(2025年)在零镜头设定中评价开量级LLMs,以检测TikTok视频记录稿的阴谋理论,发现一些提示配置实现了高精度,表现优于微调的RoBERTa基线,尽管模型和提示的性能差异很大.

blocks.en: Conspiracy detection is closely related to the broader literature on misinformation, rumors, and fake-news detection, where additional contextual and social signals have been incorporated to facilitate accurate classification.
blocks.zh: 阴谋侦测与更广泛的关于错误信息、谣言和假新闻侦测的文献密切相关,在这些文献中纳入了额外的背景和社会信号,以便于准确分类。

blocks.en:
At the content level, approaches have combined lexical, topic, hashtag, and URL features with information from the source message ( Castillo et al. 2011 ; Qazvinian et al. 2011 ) .
User- and source-level signals have also been incorporated, including user credibility and stance ( Li et al. 2019 ) , as well as source-user behavior jointly modeled with article content ( Ruchansky et al. 2017 ) .
Temporal context has been captured from sequences of related posts and user responses, modeling how rumor discussions evolve over time ( Ma et al. 2016 ) , while propagation and network structure have been represented through diffusion features ( Castillo et al. 2011 ) and graph-based approaches such as Bi-GCN, which models both top-down propagation from the source post and bottom-up dispersion through the discussion graph ( Bian et al. 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
在内容层面,方法将词汇、专题、标签和URL特征与源信息相结合(Castillo等人,2011年;Qazvinian等人,2011年)。
用户和源级信号也被纳入其中,包括用户可信度和姿态(Li等人,2019年),以及以文章内容为模式的源用户共同行为(Ruchansky等人,2017年).
从相关帖子的序列和用户的回复中抓住了时间背景,模拟了谣言讨论如何随时间演变(Ma等人,2016年),而传播和网络结构则通过传播特征(Castillo等人,2011年)和以图表为基础的方法(Bi-GCN)得到体现,这些方法通过讨论图表对源头的自上而下传播和自下而上分散进行模拟(Bian等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: Together, these works show that user’s stance, and engagement patterns, along with propagation structure, provide important signals that could be harnessed to achieve improved classification.
blocks.zh: 这些著作一起表明,用户的立场和参与模式以及传播结构提供了重要的信号,可以用来改进分类。

blocks.en:
Agentic approaches have been applied to evidence gathering and verification in misinformation detection. FactAgent decomposes fake-news verification into a structured expert workflow that combines the LLM’s internal analysis with external search and source-credibility tools ( Li et al. 2024 ) . MARO assigns subtasks such as linguistic analysis, external fact consistency, and user-comment analysis to specialized agents, and automatically optimizes the decision rules used to combine their analysis for cross-domain misinformation detection ( Li et al. 2025 ) .
An agentic LLM approach for conspiracy-endorsement detection was designed to mitigate the “Reporter Trap,” in which objective reporting is incorrectly classified as endorsement, on the PsyCoMark benchmark ( Spanakis et al. 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
在发现错误信息时采用代理方法收集和核实证据。 FactAgent将假新闻核查分解为结构化的专家工作流程,将LLM的内部分析与外部搜索和源可信工具相结合(Li等人,2024年). MARO将语言分析,外部事实一致性,用户评论分析等子任务分派给专业代理商,并自动优化用于结合其分析以进行跨域错报检测的决策规则(Li等人,2025年).
在PsyComark基准(Spanakis等人,2026年)中,客观报告被错误地归类为核准,旨在缓解“报告陷阱”。

blocks.en: We note that while the tasks of fact verification and the detection of misinformation bear similarities to the task at hand, they also differ significantly. We are not interested in the ‘truth’ value of a statement but in its pragmatic function. 7 7 7 Consider example H1 above. The factually wrong content is used as a rhetorical device, mocking and rejecting the conspiracy.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,虽然事实核查和发现错误信息的任务与目前的任务有相似之处,但它们也大不相同。 我们不关心发言的 " 真相 " 价值,而是关心其实用性。 7 7 参考上文例子H1。 事实错误的内容被用作修辞手段,嘲弄和否定阴谋.

blocks.en: While our work is inspired by these works, it leverages a distinct set of tools and evidence sources appropriate for this interpretive setting. Rather than retrieving factual evidence to verify a claim, or applying a fixed set of analytical dimensions, our agent can selectively retrieve tweet metadata, the author’s profile, prior discourse, and local ego-network context according to the needs of each case. This also distinguishes our approach from recent agentic conspiracy-detection work, which reasons primarily over the target text, retrieved examples, and limited contextual signals, without incorporating user history or broader discourse and network context. Our approach is also unsupervised, requiring no task-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的工作受到这些作品的启发,但它利用了一套与这种解释性背景相适应的独特工具和证据来源。 我们的代理商可以有选择地检索微博元数据、作者的简介、先前的言论, 这也把我们的方法与最近的代理阴谋-探测工作区分开来,后者主要针对目标文本、检索实例和有限的背景信号,而没有纳入用户历史或更广泛的言论和网络背景。 我们的方法也不受监督,不需要具体任务的微调。

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to apply an agentic framework to conspiracy detection using tools that selectively retrieve user information, prior user discourse, and network context.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,这是利用有选择地检索用户信息、用户前话语和网络背景的工具,运用代理框架进行阴谋检测的第一项工作。

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Curation
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据校正

blocks.en: We used a large archive of Hebrew-language tweets collected between December 2018 and March 2023. The archive, containing 270 million tweets posted by 3.3 million unique users, is estimated to cover 80--90% of public Hebrew Twitter during this period. 8 8 8 We used Twitter’s streaming API, tracking a list of Hebrew stopwords. The 80%–90% coverage is estimated by extrapolating the coverage achieved by the tracked terms over Hebrew tweets collected using the Decahose, which provided a random sample of 10% of the public stream.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了2018年12月至2023年3月期间收集的大量希伯来语推文档案. 该档案包含有330万独特用户张贴的2.7亿条微博,估计在此期间将覆盖80-90%的希伯来语公共Twitter. 追踪希伯来语句列表。 80~~90%的覆盖范围通过推算在使用Decahose收集的希伯来语推文上通过履带词实现的覆盖度来估算,该推文提供了10%的公共流的随机样本.

blocks.en:
We followed previous work on the creation of conspiracy datasets and used a comprehensive set of keywords in order to extract conspiracy-related content. This stage is designed to achieve “high recall”, resulting in an adversarial dataset, retaining tweets that either contain conspiracy narratives or discuss related topics (e.g., questions and legitimate concerns regarding vaccines as well as anti-vaccination content).
The retrieval rules combine topic-specific keywords and general conspiracy cues. Topics include flat-earth claims, the Rabin assassination, the Yemenite children affair, COVID, medical and pharmaceutical control, global elites and the Illuminati, QAnon, chemtrails, 9/11, climate change, the moon-landing hoax, UFOs and aliens, and the “deep state”. Brief descriptions of these topics, together with the full retrieval lexicon, are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
我们跟踪了以前关于创建阴谋数据集的工作,并使用了一套全面的关键词来提取阴谋相关内容. 这一阶段旨在实现“高召回”,从而形成一个对抗性的数据集,保留包含阴谋叙事或讨论相关议题(例如疫苗和防接种内容方面的问题和合理关切)的微博。
检索规则结合了特定主题的关键词和一般阴谋提示. 议题包括平地主张、拉宾暗杀、也门族儿童事件、COVID、医疗和药品管制、全球精英和光明日报、QAnon、化学报社、9/11、气候变化、登月骗局、UFO和外星人以及“深层国家”。 附录D简要叙述了这些专题,以及完整的检索词汇。

blocks.en: A tweet should match more than one filter in order to be considered. For example the following tweet, retrieved by the chemtrails-related rules.
blocks.zh: 微博应匹配多个过滤器才能考虑. 例如以下微博,由chematrails相关规则检索.

blocks.en: T1 “Remember the photo of the crop-duster planes I took this afternoon? Here is the result. Dirty and murky skies. This is what we breathe. This is the air pollution that’s killing us. And by the way, they blame it on us. So wake up.” 9 9 9 Original Hebrew is available in Appendix B , Example T1.
blocks.zh: T1 “还记得我今天下午拍摄的作物减压飞机的照片吗? 这就是结果。 肮脏和阴暗的天空。 这是我们的呼吸。 造成我们死亡的空气污染。 顺便说一句 他们怪罪我们 故你应当觉醒。” 9 9 希伯来文原文见附录B,例T1。

blocks.en:
The tweet matches several topic-related terms and phrases, including ‘‘air pollution’’, ‘‘plane’’, ‘‘spraying’’ 10 10 10 In Hebrew, the term used for a ‘crop-duster plane’ is a ‘spraying plane’, after its aerial application of fertilizers and pesticides. , and “sky”, together with broader conspiracy cues such as “killing us” and “wake up”. The example illustrates the purpose of the retrieval stage: the rules identify tweets containing topic-related and potentially conspiratorial signals, but do not determine the label. The full list of keywords, and retrieval rules and thresholds can be found in Appendix D .
Removing duplications, this process produced 33,121 unique tweets, each likely to relate to one of the topics listed above.
blocks.zh:
在希伯来语中, " 耕地飞机 " 的用词在空中施用肥料和杀虫剂之后是 " 喷雾飞机 " , " 天空 " ,还有 " 杀死我们 " 和 " 醒来 " 等更广泛的阴谋暗示。 该示例说明了检索阶段的目的:规则识别包含与话题相关和潜在的共谋信号的微博,但没有确定标签. 关键词的完整清单以及检索规则和阈值见附录D。
这个过程消除了重复,产生了33,121个独特的推文,每个推文都可能与上述主题之一有关。

blocks.en:
We first used Gemini 3 Flash and GPT-5 to independently classify all 33,121 candidates based on text alone, using the preliminary sampling prompt provided in Appendix A.1 .
We used disagreement between Gemini 3 Flash and GPT-5 as a signal for cases in which text-only predictions differed across models. The two models disagreed on 3,915 of the 33,121 candidates (11.8%).
blocks.zh:
我们首先使用双子座3 Flash和GPT-5,仅根据文本就对所有33 121名候选人进行独立分类,使用附录A.1提供的初步抽样提示。
我们把双子座3 Flash和GPT-5之间的分歧用作不同模型中仅文本预测有差异的情况的信号. 两种模式不同意33 121名候选人中的3 915名(11.8%)。

blocks.en: A subsample of 504 tweets was annotated by two annotators, see details in Section 3.2 below. The annotated dataset is used to evaluate our classification pipeline. Once validated, the pipeline can be applied to the larger adversarial set. The raw dataset is available to the agents to query, using the various tools.
blocks.zh: 两名注释员对504条推文作了子样本说明,详情见下文第3.2节。 附加说明的数据集被用来评估我们的分类程序。 管道一旦被验证,就可以应用于更大的对抗套装. 原始数据集可供代理商使用各种工具进行查询。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据注释

blocks.en: We sampled a set of 504 tweets for manual annotation. Cases in which Gemini 3 Flash and GPT-5 produced conflicting predictions were over-sampled. The distribution of tweets by models agreement groups is available in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 我们抽取了504条微博, 双子座3 Flash和GPT-5生成相互矛盾的预测的个案被过度采样. 按模式协议组分发的微博见表3。

blocks.en: Table 3: Composition of the evaluation set and the full candidate pool according to text-only predictions from Gemini 3 Flash and GPT-5. 0(1) indicates a prediction of not (conspiracy). Note the balanced-oversampling of ‘0 1’ and ‘1 0’.
blocks.zh: 表3:根据双子座3 Flash和GPT-5的纯文本预测,评价集的组成和全部候选人库。 0(1)表示对非(阴谋)的预测。 注意 " 0 1 " 和 " 10 " 的平衡抽样。

blocks.en: Manual annotation of conspiracy-related tweets is challenging and time consuming. The annotator is required to have a deep understanding of the different topics and related conspiracies. These involve some bizarre claims and in-group lingo, internet culture, and niche use of memes. Labels should be assigned based on the communicative function of the tweet rather than its surface wording alone, and the working definition provided by Douglas and Sutton (2023) . The adversarial construction of the dataset (see above) makes the annotation even more challenging. Informed decision is often made only after careful examination of the different contexts – a time consuming and cognitively draining undertaking.
blocks.zh: 对与阴谋有关的微博进行人工说明具有挑战性,耗费时间。 注释者必须深入了解不同的题目和相关阴谋。 这涉及到一些怪异的主张和群体内语言、互联网文化, 标签应该根据微博的交流功能而非其表面措辞,以及道格拉斯和萨顿(2023年)提供的工作定义来指定. 数据集的对抗性构建(见上文)使得注释更具挑战性. 知情决定往往是在仔细审查不同背景之后作出的,而这种背景是耗时和认知耗尽的。

blocks.en: Due to the complexity of the annotation process we took the following approach: All 504 tweets were manually labeled by two domain experts. The first annotated each tweet from scratch: model predictions were hidden and all relevant contexts were examined in order to assign the gold label. The second expert reviewed the labels assigned by the first annotator, exploring the contexts only in cases the original label seemed lacking without further evidence. In the final stage the annotators had a consolidation session, reaching agreement on the gold labels, resulting in 331 non-conspiracy tweets (65.7%) and 173 conspiracy tweets (34.3%).
blocks.zh: 由于注释过程的复杂性,我们采取了以下办法: 所有504个推文都由两名域专家手动标注. 首个附加说明的每个推文都是从零开始的:模型预测被隐藏起来,并且检查了所有相关背景,以便指定金色标签. 第二位专家审查了第一位注释员所指定的标签,只在似乎缺乏原始标签而无进一步证据的情况下才探讨背景。 在最后阶段,注释者举行了一次合并会议,就金色标签达成协议,结果有331条非阴谋性推文(65.7%)和173条阴谋性推文(34.3%)。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 The Agentic Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 代理管道

blocks.en: Agentic frameworks extend language models beyond direct generation by enabling them to interact with external tools and environments during inference. ReAct ( Yao et al. 2023 ) exemplifies this by interleaving reasoning with actions and observations in an iterative loop with an external environment, while Toolformer ( Schick et al. 2023 ) takes a more static approach, learning when and how to invoke external APIs and incorporate their outputs into generation without an ongoing interactive loop.
blocks.zh: 代理框架将语言模型扩展到直接生成之外,使其能够在推论期间与外部工具和环境互动。 reAct (姚等编). 2023 )通过将推理与动作和观察在与外部环境的迭接循环中相互切入来说明这一点,而Tolleformer(Schick等人,2023年)则采取更静态的方法,学习何时和如何引用外部API,并将其输出输入生成,而不持续的互动循环.

blocks.en: In this work we adopt the former approach. The agent is prompted with the task definition and specific guidelines introducing the available tools, regulating the tool use, and defining the input-output formats used through the reasoning and acting loop. This agentic workflow is illustrated in Figure 1 and the full prompt is available in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们采用了前一种做法。 推动代理人的是任务定义和具体准则,其中引入了可用的工具,规范了工具的使用,并界定了通过推理和动作循环使用的输入输出格式. 图1说明了这一代理工作流程,附录A.4提供了全部提示。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Full agentic workflow.
blocks.zh: 图1:全代理工作流程.

blocks.en: 4.2 Contexts and Tools
blocks.zh: 4.2 背景和工具

blocks.en:
Prior work, mostly on fake-news and misinformation, has demonstrated the utility of social context for classification tasks. Fortunately, our unique raw dataset provides a good approximation of the full knowledge of users’ public history and social interactions. A set of four tools was developed, allowing the agent to query and retrieve different types of context, as the need arises in the reasoning loop.
We note that tools only serve data that was timestamped before the target tweet was posted, masking any “futuristic” signals. The available tools are described in the remainder of this Subsection.
blocks.zh:
以前的工作,主要是关于假新闻和错误信息的工作,已经表明社会背景对于分类任务的用处。 幸运的是,我们独特的原始数据集很好地概括了用户的公共历史和社会互动的全部知识。 开发了一套四套工具,允许代理人根据推理循环的需要查询和检索不同类型的上下文.
我们注意到,工具只服务于在目标微博发布前时间戳的数据,掩盖了任何“未来”信号。 本分节其余部分介绍了现有工具。

blocks.en: Tweet Information (metadata)
blocks.zh: 图文信息(元数据)

blocks.en: The tweet-information tool retrieves metadata about the target tweet, including its timestamp, text length, hashtags, URLs, and source. These signals can situate the tweet in a temporal or topical context and indicate links to external material or unusual posting behavior.
blocks.zh: 包括时间戳、文字长度、标签、URL和源头。 这些信号可以将微博放在时间或专题上,并显示与外部材料或异常张贴行为的链接。

blocks.en: Author Information (metadata)
blocks.zh: 作者信息(元数据)

blocks.en: The author-information tool retrieves profile-level information about the tweet author, including username, display name, bio, account creation date, verification status, follower and following counts, total tweet count, language, and location when available. Such information can provide cues about the author’s identity, self-presentation, or broader account characteristics that may help interpret intent.
blocks.zh: 作者-信息工具检索有关推文作者的配置级别信息,包括用户名,显示名称,生物,账户创建日期,核实状况,跟踪者和跟踪计数,推文总计数,语言,以及可用位置. 此类信息可以提示作者的身份、自我介绍或更广泛的账户特征,有助于解释意图。

blocks.en: User History
blocks.zh: 用户历史

blocks.en: This tool samples up to 20 tweets posted by the same user in the 30 days preceding the target tweet. This context can reveal prior stance, recurring narratives, repeated references, or ongoing themes that may clarify whether the target tweet endorses, mocks, or merely references a conspiracy narrative.
blocks.zh: 此工具在目标推文发布前30天, 可能澄清目标推文是赞同、嘲笑还是仅仅提及阴谋叙事。

blocks.en: Network-Aware Ego Context
blocks.zh: 网络预知 Ego 上下文

blocks.en: The network tool recovers and returns the ego-network of the user, based on retweet interactions occurring in the 14 days preceding the target tweet. Nodes are users whose content the target author retweeted during this period. This signal provides the immediate community of the user and a glimpse into the content she recently amplified. Nodes are ranked by interaction frequency, and the five most frequently retweeted accounts are retained. For each of these nodes, the tool returns basic profile information and up to five original tweets posted during the 30 days preceding the target tweet.
blocks.zh: 网络工具恢复并返回用户的自我网络,其基础是目标推文前14天发生的重联互动. 节点(Nodes)是指目标作者在这段时间内重新转发内容的用户. 这个信号为用户提供即时的社区,并浏览她最近放大的内容. 节点按交互频率排序,五个最经常重排的账户被保留. 对于每个节点,工具返回基本配置信息以及目标推文前30天内张贴的最多5条原始推文.

blocks.en: The restrictions on the number of tweets returned (20 or 5, depending on the tool), the timespan from which we sample (14 or 30 days) or the number of neighbors considered, are applied for efficiency purposes, curbing down runtime. Our purpose here is to demonstrate the advantage of the agentic framework using the specified tools, thus optimizing these hyperparameters is beyond the scope of this work.
blocks.zh: 对返回的微博数量的限制(视工具而定为20或5),我们从中抽取的时间跨度(14或30天)或考虑的邻居数量,都是为了提高效率,抑制运行时间. 我们在这里的目的是用指定的工具来展示代理框架的优势,因此优化这些超参数超出了这项工作的范围.

blocks.en: 4.3 Baseline Models
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线模式

blocks.en: The following settings are used as baselines:
blocks.zh: 以下设置用作基线:

blocks.en: Tweet-only LLM
blocks.zh: 仅切换 LLM

blocks.en: In the most basic setting, an LLM (Gemini-3-flash) is prompted with the target tweet and the task definition. No contexts are provided, and only the tweet is considered.
blocks.zh: 在最基本的设定中,一个LLM(Gemini-3-flash)在目标微博和任务定义的推动下被激发. 不提供背景,只考虑推文。

blocks.en: Degenerate Agent
blocks.zh: 脱源代理

blocks.en: A Gemini 3-flash model stripped of its tools sets the baseline in our experiments. In this setting, the context(s) are preloaded and appended to the target tweet and the classification instructions in the original prompt. The degenerate agent does reason about the provided contexts, but it has no agency as it cannot actively decide on tool use through the reasoning loop.
blocks.zh: 双子座3-闪光模型从它的工具中剥离出来,为我们的实验设定了基线. 在此设置中,上下文被预先加载,并附在目标微博和分类指令的原始提示中. 堕落的代理人确实对所提供的背景有道理,但是它没有代理,因为它不能通过推理循环积极决定工具的使用.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Two-agent debate workflow. Analyst 2 critiques Analyst 1’s initial decision before the final prediction.
blocks.zh: 图2:双代理辩论工作流程. 分析员2在最后预测之前批评分析员1的初步决定。

blocks.en: Agents-debate Baseline
blocks.zh: 代理人辩论基线

blocks.en:
Multi-agent debates provide a complementary mechanism for exposing alternative interpretations through critique and reconsideration ( Liang et al. 2024 ; Han et al. 2025 ; Liu et al. 2025 ) . We use a simple debate setting in which one model (Analyst 1) classifies a target tweet, then invites another model (Analyst 2) to debate and criticize its reasoning and classification decisions. Analyst 2 is instructed to pay particular attention to possible non-literal interpretations.
Given the critical response provided by Analyst 2, Analyst 1 re-weighs her position and produces the final decision. Analyst a i a_{i} is only exposed to the target tweet and to the reasoning and decisions made by the other analyst. This workflow is illustrated in Figure 2 and the respective prompts and protocol are available in Appendix A.6 . Note that the analysts differ both in the assigned persona and in the foundation model used – Gemini-3-flash and GPT-5 as Analysts 1 and 2, respectively.
blocks.zh:
多代理人辩论为通过批评和重新考虑揭露其他解释提供了补充机制(梁等. 2024; 韩等. 2025; 刘等 2025). 我们使用一个简单的辩论环境,其中一个模型(Analyst 1)将目标微博分类,然后邀请另一个模型(Analyst 2)辩论并批评其推理和分类决定. 指示分析员2特别注意可能的非文体解释。
鉴于分析员2、分析员1提供了批评性答复,她重新评价了自己的立场,作出了最后决定。 Analysis a i a_{i}只接触到目标微博, 图2说明了这一工作流程,附录A.6提供了相应的提示和协议。 请注意,分析师在指定人物a和所使用的基础模型上都有所不同——双子座-3-flash和GPT-5分别作为分析师1和2.

blocks.en: 4.4 Experimental Setting
blocks.zh: 4.4 实验设置

blocks.en:
We formulate the task as binary tweet-level classification. Given a target Hebrew tweet, the system predicts whether it should be labeled as conspiracy (1) or non-conspiracy (0). In all settings, the model (agent) returns a structured output containing the predicted label along with a short rationale (see Table 2 ).
We report accuracy, precision, recall and F-Score over the annotated dataset, establishing the basic performance of each model and setting.
blocks.zh:
我们制定的任务 是二进制的微博级别分类。 鉴于一个目标希伯来语的推文,系统预测是应该标注为阴谋(1)还是非阴谋(0). 在所有设置中,模型(代理)返回包含预测标签的结构化输出以及一个简短的理由(见表2 ).
我们报告附加说明的数据集的准确性、准确性、回顾性和F-Score,确定每个模型和设置的基本性能。

blocks.en: Our experimental settings, described below, aim to separate three factors that are often conflated in context-aware classification: (i) the availability of contextual evidence; (ii) the type of evidence provided; and (iii) the mechanism through which that evidence is accessed.
blocks.zh: 下文介绍的我们的实验环境旨在区分三个因素,这些因素往往被混入上下文分类中:(一) 是否有相关证据;(二) 所提供的证据类型;(三) 获取证据的机制。

blocks.en: We thus have two main experimental settings: the Preloaded mode, using degenerate agents, and the Agentic mode . In the Preloaded mode the agent receive the context by default, whereas in the Agentic mode agents determine whether to access a context and when.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们有两个主要的实验设置:使用变质剂的预装模式和Agentic模式。 在预加载模式中,代理默认接收上下文,而在代理模式中,代理代理决定是否访问上下文以及何时访问.

blocks.en: Within each of these settings, we assess the contribution of each context/tool separately and in a full setting in which all contexts/tools are available to the agent. The various settings are further explained in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 在其中每一种情况下,我们分别评估每个上下文/工具的贡献,并在一个完全的环境下向代理人提供所有上下文/工具。 表4进一步解释了各种设置。

blocks.en: Table 4: Experimental conditions evaluated in the study.
blocks.zh: 表4:研究评估的实验条件.

blocks.en: The agentic workflows were implemented using LangChain ( Chase 2022 ) and LangGraph ( LangChain, Inc. 2024 ) . Gemini-3-Flash was used for the text-only baseline and all single-agent LLM conditions. GPT-5 was used as the second agent in the debate setting. Temperature was set to 0.2 in all settings. Full prompts are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 代理工作流程使用LangChain(大通2022年)和LangGraph(LangChain, Inc. 2024年)执行. 双子座-3-Flash用于仅文本基线和所有单代理LLM条件. GPT-5被用作辩论设置中的第二剂. 在所有设置中,温度设定为0.2。 附录A提供了全部提示。

blocks.en: 5 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 结果和分析

blocks.en: All settings (Table 4 ) were first evaluated on the annotated dataset. We report overall accuracy and precision, recall and F1-score with respect to the positive class. Classification results complement with error analysis.
blocks.zh: 所有设置(表4)首先在附加说明的数据集中进行评估。 我们报告总的准确性和准确性、召回和F1-分数的正数。 分类结果与错误分析相辅相成。

blocks.en: We follow the classification results with analysis of the tool usage: exploring the utility, usage frequency, and temporal patterns in which tools are used.
blocks.zh: 我们跟踪分类结果,分析工具的使用情况:探索工具的用途、使用频率和时间模式。

blocks.en: Finally, based on all reasoning steps, we explore the input/output tradeoff (in “token economy”) between the agentic and the degenerate frameworks.
blocks.zh: 最后,根据所有推理步骤,我们探讨代理人框架与退化框架之间的投入/产出权衡(在“托肯经济”中)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 总体业绩

blocks.en:
All classification results are presented in Table 5 .
The baseline results are established by the Text-only LLM with accuracy of 0.6 and F1-score of 0.535.
Best over-all performance (accuracy of 0.790 and F-score of 0.73) are achieved by the full agentic framework (all tools available). In comparison, the degenerate agent using all contexts achieves an accuracy of 0.707 and F-score of 0.67.
Allowing only one tool, the best results are achieved with the User History context (Accuracy: 0.748; F: 0.698), outperforming the Degenerate Agent with full context. This last result demonstrates the benefits of using the agentic framework, compared to the use of elaborated contexts as input.

blocks.zh: 双代理辩论框架的绩效超过了单一的LLM基线,但与所有其他设置相比还很短.

blocks.en: These results confirm, yet again, the challenge in conspiracy detection and the need for contexts, especially over our “adversarial” dataset.

blocks.en: 5.2 Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.2 错误分析

blocks.en: In order to gain insight into the performance of the agent, we explore cases in which both the agent and the baseline erred as well as instances in which the baseline provided the correct classification while the agent misclassified it.
blocks.zh: 为了深入了解代理人的性能,我们探索了代理人和基线都错误的情况,以及基准提供了正确的分类,而代理人却错误分类的情况.

blocks.en: Although achieving a significant overall improvement (F1 0.53 → 0.73 0.53\rightarrow 0.73 ), in some cases, the agent (all tools available) misclassified tweets that were correctly classified by the baseline, 78% of these are false positives. This result reminds us that sometimes words should be taken at face value and incomplete contexts, often depending on hyperparameter settings, may distort the interpretation.
blocks.zh: 虽然取得了显著的整体改进(F1 0.53 ~ 0.73 0.53\ 右侧0.73),但在某些情况下,被基准正确分类的代理(所有可用的工具)微博被错误分类,其中78%是假阳性. 这一结果提醒我们,有时应当以面值来看待文字,不完全的上下文,往往取决于超参数设置,可能会扭曲解释.

We qualitatively explored the cases over which both the baseline and the agent erred. We find that these cases fall under two main categories: (i) Failure to distinguish conspiracy claims from strong political or constitutional criticism and accusations of corruption. (ii) Tweets that explicitly mock a conspiracy theory or
discuss it without endorsing it.
The following tweets, respectively, illustrate the two categories: (a) “I propose a different compromise… that the Netanyahu trial (the spectacle) take place in my backyard… Half the nation is certain that cases were fabricated here to carry out a coup. blocks.en: 5.4 Analysis of ‘Token Economy’
blocks.zh: 5.4 `经济基础 ' 的分析 ' ' 说

blocks.en:
Token Economy is a colloquial term often used to describe, estimate, and manage the costs of LLM usage. Generally speaking, tokens are used in three distinct stages: input tokens in the prompt, generated tokens at the output, and reasoning tokens. Reasoning tokens may not be visible to the user and are often considered as “hidden” generated output. However, some models explicitly output the intermediate reasoning steps. API providers often charge per token, usually charging different rates for input and output tokens.
Agentic frameworks introduce a tradeoff between input, reasoning and output tokens. While initial prompts are typically shorter, the reasoning loops and the retrieved information may result in a significant increase in the use of reasoning and (intermediate) output tokens ( Bai et al. 2026 ) .
These frameworks and billing policies directly translate tokens into dollar cost, creating real economic incentives to minimize token usage ( Bergemann et al. 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
Token Economy是一个常用于描述,估计和管理LLM使用成本的学术术语. 一般说来,令牌在三个不同的阶段使用:即时输入令牌,输出时生成令牌,推理令牌. 说明理由的符号可能无法为用户所看到,往往被视为“隐藏”产生的产出。 然而,有些模型明确输出中间推理步骤. API提供商经常每枚令牌收费,通常对输入和输出令牌收取不同的费率.
代理框架引入了输入,推理和输出符之间的权衡. 虽然初始提示通常较短,但推理循环和检索到的信息可能导致推理和(中间)输出符的使用显著增加(Bai等人,2026年).
这些框架和计费政策直接将象征性地转化为美元成本,创造了实际的经济激励,以尽量减少象征性的使用(Bergemann等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: While we do not have direct access to token usage, 11 11 11 Not all reasoning is available and specific token counts depend on the model’s BPE and other optimization practices we can provide a rough estimate through the number of initial and intermediate input and output character count.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们没有直接获得象征性使用,但11 11 并非所有推理都可用,具体的符号计数取决于模型的BPE和其他优化做法,我们可以通过初始和中间输入和输出字符计数的数量提供粗略的估计.

blocks.en:
The best performing agent (all tools available) used an average of 11,434 input characters per instance, across all tool calls, compared with an average of only 8,251 characters in the degenerate agent setting with full context. The numbers of output characters produced (final and intermediate) by the models are 1048 (agent) and 614 (degenerate agent). On average, our agent consumes ∼ × 1.5 \sim\times 1.5 input characters and ∼ × 2 \sim\times 2 , a noneligible tradeoff that should be considered in light of the a improvement in accuracy (0.707 → \rightarrow 0.79) and F-score (0.67 → \rightarrow 0.73) and frequently changing billing policies.
A more thorough analysis of this tradeoff is beyond the scope of this work.

对这种权衡的更透彻的分析超出了这项工作的范围。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
The error patterns suggest that the central challenge in conspiracy-tweet
classification is not merely recognizing conspiratorial content, but
inferring the underlying function of the utterance, the illocutionary act, in terms of speech acts theory Austin (1975) . These two examples (original language in Appendix B ) illustrate the challenge and the benefits of the agentic framework:
blocks.zh:
错误模式表明,阴谋诡计的中心挑战
分类不仅仅是承认共谋的内容,而且
从语音行为理论中推断出语音的基本功能,即不规则行为(Austin)(1975年). 这两个例子(附录B的原始语言)说明了代理框架的挑战和好处:

blocks.en: D1: “My brother texted me about how lemons kill cancer cells and can treat several types of cancer, and how pharmaceutical companies are hiding it from us. And I’m considered the black sheep of the family.” D2: “‘The Zombie Guide: The term ‘conspiracy theory’ is already passé. From now on, when you encounter a truth you cannot or do not want to investigate, instead of saying ‘conspiracy theory,’ say: the Earth is flat. That way, you can avoid thinking about and investigating the frightening truth”
blocks.zh: D1:“我哥哥给我发短信说柠檬如何杀死癌细胞,如何治疗几种癌症,以及制药公司如何瞒着我们。 我被视为家庭的黑羊。 D2: " 僵尸指南:`阴谋论 ' 一词已经过去。 从现在开始,当你遇到一个真理时,你不能或不想调查,而不是说`阴谋论':地球是平的。 这样,你可以避免思考和调查可怕的事实。”

blocks.en:
The first tweet quotes a conspiratorial message verbatim, but uses the concluding words to mock it. Text-only LLMs tend to misinterpret this as ‘sheep’ metaphor is common in the conspiratorial discourse. The second example seems to mock conspiracy theories while in fact it promotes them by mocking its critiques. With contexts, however, the agents correctly classify the utterances.
Context appears to help by calibrating the textual interpretation rather than merely adding more text. User history can reveal recurring stance,
rhetorical style, and narrative participation, while author and
ego-network information provide additional cues about the social and
discursive setting of a post.
blocks.zh:
第一则推文引用了密谋性信息逐字逐句,但使用结论词来嘲讽. 只有文字的LLMs倾向于将这一点误解为在阴谋论中常见的"羊"比喻. 第二个例子似乎嘲弄阴谋论,而事实上却通过嘲弄其批评来宣传这些理论。 然而,根据具体情况,代理人对言论进行正确的分类。
上下文似乎有助于校准案文解释,而不是仅仅增加更多的案文。 用户历史可以显示反复出现的立场,
修辞风格和叙事参与,而作者和
自我网络信息提供了更多关于社会和
旋转的设置 。

blocks.en: Interestingly, the two analysts (agents) in the debate settings initially disagreed on 17.9% of the target tweets. Following the critique offered by Analyst 2, Analyst 1 reversed her decision in 60% of the cases. Of these changes, (66.7%) corrected an initial error, while a correct decision was reversed in 33.3% of the cases. While the debate’s overall performance was unimpressive, this framework shows clear potential. This direction will be explored in future work.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,辩论环境的两位分析家(代理人)最初不同意17.9%的目标推文. 在分析员2、分析员1提出批评后,她的决定在60%的案件中被推翻。 在这些变化中,(66.7%)纠正了最初的错误,而在33.3%的案件中,正确的决定被推翻。 虽然辩论的总体表现并不令人印象深刻,但这一框架显示出明显的潜力。 今后的工作将探讨这一方向。

blocks.en:
This work comes with some limitations. First, hyper parameters were not optimized. This work serves as a convincing proof of concept for the utility of the agentic framework on the specific task and over a challenging adversarial dataset. As such we did not optimize hyperparameters or explored other possible settings, e.g., using other LLMs in the different settings.
Consequently, the analysis of the results and the errors apply to this dataset and the specific models used. Other or future models may perform differently in terms of reasoning or token efficiency.
blocks.zh:
这项工作有一些局限性。 第一,超参数没有优化。 这项工作令人信服地证明了代理框架在具体任务上的效用,也证明了具有挑战性的对抗数据集。 因此,我们没有优化超参数或探索其他可能设置,例如在不同设置中使用其他LLMs。
因此,对结果和错误的分析适用于本数据集和所使用的具体模型。 其他或未来的模型在推理或象征性效率方面可能表现不同.

blocks.en: The use of user histories and network/social context should be attuned to privacy considerations, particularly when user-level information is retained, analyzed, or released. Moreover, incorrectly labeling a user may incur social costs. The system is therefore better suited to research purposes rather than as an automated moderation tool without human review.
blocks.zh: 用户历史和网络/社会背景的使用应当适应隐私方面的考虑,特别是在用户一级的信息被保留、分析或发布时。 此外,错误地给用户贴上标签可能带来社会成本。 因此,该系统更适合研究目的,而不是作为不经人类审查的自动节制工具。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
This paper examined Hebrew conspiracy-tweet classification as a context-dependent interpretation task. Using a large local archive of Hebrew
tweets and a targeted evaluation set of manually labeled tweets, we find that agentic approach performs significantly better than other approaches, even when the exact same contextual information is available.
Our findings suggest treating conspiracy detection on social media as a socially embedded interpretation problem rather than purely a
text-classification problem.
blocks.zh:
本文将希伯来阴谋和诡辩分类视为一种依赖背景的解释任务。 使用大量希伯来语本地档案
我们发现,即使有完全相同的背景信息,代理方法的表现也大大优于其他方法。
我们的调查结果表明,将社交媒体的阴谋调查视为一个社会嵌入式解释问题,而不是纯粹的
文本分类问题。

blocks.en: ⬇ You classify Hebrew tweets according to their degree of conspiratorial content . Important distinction : criticism , ridicule , or sarcasm toward conspiracy theories should be classified as non_conspiracy . Irony will often appear as exaggeration , humorous tone , or ridicule without promoting a secret plot . If the author describes conspiracy theories in order to refute or ridicule them , classify the tweet as non_conspiracy even if conspiracy - related content is mentioned . Task : Classify each tweet at two levels : 1. Label : whether the text is conspiratorial (" conspiracy " / " non_conspiracy ") 2. Score : degree of conspiratorial content between 0 and 1 In addition , characterize the text according to the following criteria ( one or more may apply ): 1. A claim involving a secret connection or hidden plot 2. Contradiction of an accepted official explanation or position 3. Use of unreliable sources or vague language (" they say ...", " everyone knows ...") 4. Encouragement of distrust toward major institutions ( government , science , media , etc .) 5. An " us versus them " framing Input : You will receive a list of tweets . Each tweet has a row_id and text . Required output : Return only valid JSON as a list of objects , in the same order and with the same number of items as the input . For each item , return : { " row_id ": " the received identifier ", " label ": " conspiracy " or " non_conspiracy ", " score ": number between 0 and 1, " signals ": [ list of numbers from {1,2,3,4,5}], " rationale ": " two short sentences explaining the classification " } Rules : - Keep the response short and clear . - Do not add any text outside the JSON . - Make sure to distinguish conspiratorial claims from irony or ridicule .

blocks.en: ⬇ You classify whether a Hebrew tweet is conspiracy or non_conspiracy . First , decide whether the tweet can be confidently classified from the text alone . If yes , do not use any tools . Only if the tweet is ambiguous ( e . g ., sarcasm , mockery , exaggeration , or unclear intent ) and additional context could change the decision , you may use tools . When using tools , choose them based on the missing information and use as few as necessary . Stop using tools once you can confidently classify the tweet . If a tool does not help , you may try a different tool . Tool usage rules : - tweet_info -> returns metadata ( tweet date , text length , hashtags , URLs , posting source ). Can be used to interpret hashtags and links , understand the timing of the tweet , and identify how it was posted ( e . g ., automated or unusual sources ). - user_info -> returns profile ( bio , account age , followers , verification , language ). Can be used when the author ’ s identity can help understand intent . Can help identify ideological alignment , suspicious / bot - like users , or unusual account characteristics . - previous_tweets -> returns earlier tweets by the same user with dates and text . Can be used to discover repeated narratives , consistent stance , or ongoing themes that indicate genuine belief rather than a one - off joke . - ego_context -> returns top interacting users , their profile , and recent tweets . Can be used to understand the typical language and tone of the community ( what is normal vs unusual ). Neighbors ’ recent tweets can indicate what topics , claims , and narratives are currently discussed in the user ’ s surrounding community , helping interpret an ambiguous tweet . Return only valid JSON : { " label ": 0 or 1, " score ": number between 0 and 1, " rationale ": short explanation grounded in the tool outputs } Rules : - score - conspiracy confidence (0 = not conspiracy , 1 = conspiracy ) - If you used tools , ground the rationale in those tool outputs and explicitly attribute evidence to tweet metadata , user profile , user history , or ego - context .

blocks.en: The candidate-retrieval process covers the following conspiracy topics and related narratives:
blocks.zh: 候选人检索程序包括下列阴谋论题和相关叙述:

blocks.en: • Flat-earth claims: The belief that Earth is a flat disc rather than a sphere, and that space agencies, governments, and scientists worldwide are colluding to fake evidence (like satellite images) of a round Earth. • Rabin assassination: Beyond the established fact that Yigal Amir shot Israeli PM Yitzhak Rabin in 1995, various theories claim the Israeli security service (Shin Bet) orchestrated or deliberately allowed the assassination, sometimes alleging a broader plot involving multiple shooters or government complicity. • Yemenite children affair: Refers to the disappearance of hundreds of infants, mostly from Yemenite Jewish immigrant families, in Israel during the 1950s. While official inquiries attributed most cases to poor record-keeping and high infant mortality, conspiracy theories allege a systematic, state-orchestrated program to kidnap the children and give them to Ashkenazi families or sell them abroad. • COVID conspiracy theories: A range of claims including that the virus was deliberately engineered and released (sometimes tied to bio weapons labs), that the pandemic was exaggerated or fabricated to control populations, or that vaccines were designed to cause harm, implant tracking devices, or serve population-control agendas. • Medical and pharmaceutical control: The belief that pharmaceutical companies, medical associations, and regulators suppress cheap or natural cures (for cancer, etc.) to protect profits from ongoing treatments, and/or that vaccines and medications are pushed for financial or population-control motives rather than genuine health benefits. • Global elites and the Illuminati: The theory that a secretive group of powerful individuals or families (sometimes named after the historical 18th-century Bavarian Illuminati) secretly controls world governments, economies, and media to advance a hidden agenda, often toward a “New World Order.” • QAnon: A wide-ranging theory originating in 2017 alleging that a cabal of Satan-worshipping, child-trafficking elites in government, media, and business secretly runs the world, and that a hidden figure (“Q”) was leaking insider information about an anticipated reckoning against them. • Chemtrails: The claim that visible trails left by aircraft are not ordinary condensation (contrails) but chemical or biological agents deliberately sprayed for purposes like weather control, population control, or geoengineering, hidden from the public. • 9/11 conspiracy theories: Various claims disputing the official account of the September 11, 2001 attacks, including that the U.S. government had foreknowledge and allowed them to happen (“LIHOP”), directly orchestrated them (“MIHOP”), or that the World Trade Center towers were brought down by controlled demolition rather than the plane impacts and fires. • Climate change denial/conspiracy: Claims that anthropogenic climate change is a hoax or exaggeration fabricated by scientists, governments, or organizations for financial gain, political control, or to justify regulatory overreach, despite the strong scientific consensus supporting human-caused warming. • Moon-landing hoax: The claim that NASA’s Apollo moon landings (1969–1972) were staged, often in a film studio, to win the Cold War space race against the Soviet Union, and that supposed anomalies in photos and footage prove fabrication. • UFOs and aliens: Theories ranging from claims that governments (especially the U.S.) have made contact with or recovered extraterrestrial spacecraft/beings and covered it up, to beliefs that aliens have influenced human history or secretly live among us. • The “deep state”: The belief that a hidden, unelected network of career bureaucrats, intelligence officials, and other entrenched interests secretly wields real power behind the scenes, undermining or controlling elected officials regardless of who holds office.
